title: Happy Happy Happy Cat
blurb: The Happy Happy Happy cat song — a chirpy little tune attached to the most content creature the internet has ever produced, and one of TikTok's most protected wholesome audios. The internet runs almost entirely on irony, which makes this notable: there is no joke hiding underneath, no twist, no bait. It is sincerely happy and everyone has quietly agreed not to ruin it. Play it for good news, small victories, and pets doing anything whatsoever. Pure serotonin, delivered in under ten seconds.
origin: The viral 'happy happy happy' cat meme song from TikTok.
